Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for activities in assay CHEMBL4649971. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join compound_structures on molregno, join assays on assay_id, and filter by assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649971'. Keep only rows where standard_value is not null and standard_relation is '='. Do not deduplicate. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
